crossRefs.note: “But if you do at all go back, and hold fast to the remnant of these nations, even these who remain among you, and make…
know for a certainty that Yahweh your God will no longer drive these nations from out of your sight; but they shall be…
all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, even all the Sidonians. I will drive them out…
Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.
I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I…
I will send an angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite…
Observe that which I command you today. Behold, I will drive out before you the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Hittite…
then Yahweh will drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess nations greater and mightier…
then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all…
You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.

translations.web: Yahweh your God will thrust them out from before you, and drive them from out of your sight. You shall possess their land, as Yahweh your God spoke to you.
translations.bsb: The LORD your God will push them out of your way and drive them out before you, so that you can take possession of their land, as the LORD your God promised you.
translations.kjv: And the LORD your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as the LORD your God hath promised
translations.asv: And Jehovah your God, he will thrust them out from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as Jehovah your God spake unto you.
